meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后,它会对比 HEAD 与 oh-my-opencode、oh-my-openagent、lazycodex-ai 的最新已发布 npm 版本,读实际 diff,按发布层列出未发布的改动,并给出分层与整体的版本号建议。它直接输出分析,不提问。
howto.when: 当你提到 unpublished changes、changelog、what changed、whats new 等关键词,或要求对比 HEAD 与最新已发布版本时触发。

say.note: 直接输出分析,不会提问

howto.what_en: Compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions of oh-my-opencode, oh-my-openagent and lazycodex-ai, reads the real diffs, and lists unpublished changes by release layer with a layered impact matrix and version recommendations. It answers immediately, with no questions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention unpublished changes, changelog, what changed or whats new, or ask what changed since the last published npm release.

say_en.text: List the unpublished changes vs the latest published version
What version bump does oh-my-opencode need for these changes?
Write the changelog, grouped by release layer
